data.name: Anirban
data.gender_notes: Anirban is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anirban means 'without a rival'. It is a name of Lord Shiva, symbolizing his supreme power and uniqueness. The name Anirban carries the meaning “Without a rival” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Anirban usually hope their child will grow to embody without a rival and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anirban is a divine name, signifying the absence of rivalry and the ultimate power of the universe. It is a name of Lord Shiva, who is beyond comparison.
data.etymology: Anirban belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Without a rival.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anirban total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anirban holds cultural significance in Hinduism as it represents the concept of being the best and having no equal. It is a strong and powerful name that evokes confidence and a sense of superiority.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Anirban is connected to Lord Shiva, who is depicted as the ultimate deity, not having any peer or equal in the whole universe. This name signifies the deep and profound connection between the individual and the divine, emphasizing the uniqueness and supremacy of the Self in the universe. It is a reminder to constantly strive for personal growth and excellence, realizing that we are all reflections of the divine and possess infinite potential.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Anirban translates to 'without a beginning or end'. This name symbolizes the eternal nature of the soul, reminding us of our connection to the infinite universe. It encourages us to live in the present moment, while acknowledging the continuity of life beyond our physical existence.

historical_references.reference: Anirban was the name of a great Bengali poet and philosopher, who lived in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. He is known for his works in Bengali poetry and philosophy, which were influenced by Vedanta and Buddhism. Anirban is considered a pioneer of the modern Bengali literary movement.

Anirban is remembered for his bravery and dedication to the cause of Indian independence.
